provenance.movement_reasoning: Marisol's entry bowl, bedroom chair, bedside table, and kitchen counter are stable reset points; her work trips bring carried essentials back to those anchors. The teens' school gear repeatedly returns from trips to the kitchen-table/bedroom zone, while homework and meals displace it around the contested table. Bathroom routines leave bottles, towels, and occasionally the borrowed brush out; laundry, dish work, and tidying restore shared household items. Living-room viewing, gaming, and social time leave the remote, controller, blanket, and devices around the sofa until a tidy-up or clean.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A single parent working a fixed daytime healthcare schedule shares a compact home with two close-in-age teens whose school materials, devices, and differing tidiness levels create believable object movement.
